thread:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired for service `inference-hosted-api` (high error rate). Incident ID: PD-99213. Primary on-call: maya.

pagerduty: Alert details: service=inference-hosted-api, symptom=5xx-rate > 8% for 2m, region=us-west-2, escalated_to=secondary after 3m.

maya: saw this — on my way. currently on commute, mobile DND on. not sure i can ack from phone reliably.

sam: hey — noticed customer error spikes in prod graphs too, dashboards show 502s from runtime nodes. tagging @maya in case you can take.

incident-bot: PD escalation: primary did not acknowledge within 3m. Paging secondary on-call: lina.

lina: acked. grabbing context. any customer-facing symptoms documented?

jonathan: just pulled logs — spikes align with a bad model rollout that started ~6:13pm UTC. routing policy tried new model variant `gptx-30b-quant-v2` then fell back but KV cache overflowed causing timeouts.

maya: thanks. i'm inbound but might be 10min. lina, can you start mitigations? if this is rollout-related, revert routing policy or pin traffic to stable variant.

lina: starting with quick rollback. running:

```bash
# pin hosted API routing to stable model
curl -X POST https://internal-api.redwood/api/v1/routing/pin \
  -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACTED' \
  -d '{"service":"inference-hosted-api","model":"gptx-30b-stable","duration":"30m"}'
```

sam: good call. i'm spinning up extra fallback capacity on dedicated pool as a safe path. `rk scale pool dedicated-inference --replicas 4`

incident-bot: PD update: secondary acknowledged at +6m. Manager escalation scheduled after 20m if incident persists.

ops-manager: paging in — I'm awake. how bad is customer impact? any paid customers affected?

jonathan: customer impact: Real-time API latency spiked 3x, a subset of requests start returning 502/504. Affects hosted customers in us-west-2 only. Estimated affected requests ~1.2k/min at peak. No billing anomalies yet.

ops-manager: okay. Lina/maya coordinate public comms? we may need an incident banner if this lasts.

lina: rollback applied — routing now pinned to stable. I see error rate dropping but still noisy. KV cache evictions are high, looks like memory pressure on several runtime pods.

sam: dedicated pool added, started draining some traffic via canary. running quick health check: `curl -sS https://hosted-api.prod/health | jq .` shows 200 on fallback nodes.

maya: i'm on laptop now. checking rollout job and kernel logs. can confirm the quantized variant introduced a regression in kv cache sizing. patching operator to limit parallel inits.

incident-bot: PD escalation: manager notified (ops-manager). If no ack from manager in 20m, will escalate to director.

ops-manager: ack. thanks. please list customers with active sessions in the window. we'll offer help and a status update.

jonathan: exporting traces now — attaching sample error snippet:

```
2026-03-14T18:14:02Z runtime[worker-23]: WARN KVCacheEvict: capacity_exceeded=1.2GB used=1.25GB limit=1.2GB
2026-03-14T18:14:03Z runtime[worker-23]: ERROR handler: request_id=abc123 latency=1200ms status=504 model=gptx-30b-quant-v2
```

lina: error rate back to ~1.2% after pin — still above baseline but much better. continuing to monitor 5m window.

maya: deploy job for quant-v2 is paused. i'll open a rollback PR to our model catalog and add a guard to the deployment pipeline to check kv cache metrics before rollout.

sam: for immediate mitigation, i recommend: 1) keep routing pinned for 30m, 2) maintain extra dedicated pool until tomorrow morning, 3) add an autoscaling buffer for KV cache init.

ops-manager: agree. schedule postmortem and customer outreach. Lina/Maya draft status page blurb: short, say region impacted, degraded for 25m, mitigation steps, and ETA for root cause analysis.

lina: drafting status update now: "We experienced elevated error rates in US-WEST-2 for the hosted inference API between 18:13–18:38 UTC due to a model rollout that increased memory pressure on runtime nodes. Traffic has been pinned to a stable model and error rates are returning to normal. We are investigating and will follow up with a detailed postmortem."

maya: thumbs. also adding mitigations in postmortem: add pre-rollout mem-pressure checks, tighten canary ramp, and add PD policy to shorten primary-to-secondary timeout for high-customer-impact services.

pagerduty: PD note: Manager escalation timer canceled — incident acknowledged by ops-manager at +12m. Incident state: mitigated (monitoring).

sam: monitoring shows steady decrease. i'll keep the extra pool for 12 hours and then reduce if no regressions.

ops-manager: thanks team. can you all add timelines and decision logs to the incident tracker? i'll assign follow-ups: postmortem owner = maya, customer comms = lina, infra fixes = sam.

lina: added notes and assigned tasks in tracker. closing communication loop with support.

incident-bot: Incident PD-99213 closed by maya at 2165432165. Duration: 12m 45s.

maya: closing thread. great work everyone. :heart:
